facts.fact: eSanjeevani, the Health Ministry's National Telemedicine Service, has a patient-to-doctor service (eSanjeevaniOPD) for consulting a doctor from home on a smartphone or laptop
facts.quote: 2. Patient to Provider telemedicine platform: it empowers citizens to access health services in the confines of their homes through smartphones or laptops etc.

facts.fact: eSanjeevani consultations are free of cost
facts.quote: by providing free of cost consultations to one and all.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; recommends eSanjeevani OPD (esanjeevani.mohfw.gov.in) for a free online doctor consultation from home, cited.
summary: Added from the eSanjeevani About page: patient-to-doctor teleconsultation from home on smartphone/laptop, free of cost.
